newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Muted demand seen for Hotel Prop warrants.
newsitem.headline: Muted demand seen for Hotel Prop warrants.

text.p: Citibank N.A.'s announcement on Monday of a 25 million call warrant issue on shares in developer Hotel Properties Ltd produced a muted response from dealers on Monday.

The bank, part of Citicorp, said in a statement earlier it would issue the one-year warrants for Singapore $0.586325 each at a strike price of Singapore $2.115. The warrants carry a 14.95 percent premium and a gearing of 4.0.
"I'd be surprised if the offer would be taken up," said one dealer. "I wouldn't call it very attractive. It's probably a good leverage play if you've already got exposure to the stock."
Hotel Properties shares were unchanged at S$2.35 at 0430 GMT.

Citibank gave no reason for the warrants issue but said in a statement its subsidiary and associated companies had interests in the hotel, property, food and beverage and retail and leisure sectors. The group has a portfolio of hotels in seven countries.
The placing and issue of the warrants is being lead-managed by brokerage Vickers Ballas & Co Pte Ltd.
Dealing in the warrants is expected to begin on December 11, Citibank said.
Officials at Citibank and Vickers declined further comment on the issue.
One dealer said there was a strong chance that the warrant announcement was linked to two large off-market crosses in Hotel Properties stock in early morning trade on Monday.
The first deal was five million shares traded at S$2.35 and the second was 1.2 million shares at S$2.36.
